property_summary: For any non-empty _tos array and any callee address, C always performs external calls to the callee's transferFrom for each entry (so if the callee reverts then C.transfer reverts); the mutant that removes those calls will never revert even when the callee would revert, violating that rule for inputs where the callee reverts.
change_summary: Move the call to after the loop body by swapping the call into an else branch (effectively deleting the call), causing behavior to differ via not invoking external calls (revert differences when callee would revert).
